questions.question: Find the square root of 1485961.
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

Here we use elimination method for finding the square root of 1485961

The unit digit of no. 1485961 is 1

We have 4 options 1213, 1219, 1229 and 1239

We get unit digit 1 when we square a no. that ends with 1 or 9. So, option (1) 1213 is eliminated.

Now we take the square of 1220 that is > 1219 and 1485961, so we can say that 1485961 is the square of 1219.

questions.question: If a² + b² = 80 and ab = 32, then calculate the value of frac{{a - b}}{{a + b}}.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a² + b² = 80 and ab = 32

**Formula used:**

(a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab

(a – b)2 = a2 + b2 – 2ab 

**Calculation:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab = 80 + 2 × 32 = 80 + 64 = 144

⇒ a + b = 12

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab = 80 – 2 × 32 = 80 – 64 = 16

⇒ a – b = 4

frac{{a - b}}{{a + b}} = (4)/({12)} = (1)/(3) = 0.333~

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Let a = 4 and b = 8, then a² = 4² = 16 and b² = 64

then a2 + b2 = 16 + 64 = 80 satisfied

So, frac{{a - b}}{{a + b}} = (4)/({12)} = (1)/(3) = 0.333~

questions.question: If the radius of a circle is decreased by 25% of its original value, calculate the percentage decrease in the area of the circle.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Percentage decrease in radius of circle = 25%

**Formula used:**

Area of circle = πr²

where r → radius of the circle

**Calculation:**

The radius of the circle is r.

If the radius of a circle is decreased by 25%

New radius = r - r × 0.25 = 0.75r

Old Area = πr²

New Area = π × (0.75r)² = π × 0.5625r² = 0.5625πr²

percentage decrease in the area of the circle = (πr²-0.5625πr²)/(πr²)× 100=43.75%

∴ Area of the circle is decreased by 43.75%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Percentage decrease = 25 + 25 - (25 × 25/100) = 43.75%

**Calculation:**

Let ratio of A, B and C be 5x, 3x and 4x

Total Sum = Rs. 2489

New sum after diminishing the amount

questions.question: Average of 14 numbers is 32. If the average of last 5 numbers is 26, then what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 14 numbers = 32

Average of last 5 number = 26

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of all observation ÷ no. of observation

**Calculation:**

Sum of 14 number = 32 × 14

Sum of last 5 numbers = 5 × 26

∴ Average of remaining numbers __ = frac{{14 × 32 - 5 × 26}}{{14 - 5}} = frac{{448 - 130 }}{9} = frac{{318 }}{9} = 35.33__

questions.question: A person borrows some money for 8 years at a rate of simple interest. If the ratio of principal and total interest is 5 : 8, then what is the rate (in percentage) of interest?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of Principal and Interest = 5 : 8

Time = 8 years

**Formula used:**

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

where P → Principal 

R → rate of interest and 

T → Time period

**Calculation:**

Principal : Interest = 5 : 8

So, S.I. = 8a and P = 5a

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 8a = (5a × R × 8)/100

∴ R = (100 × 8a)/(5a × 8) = 20%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**Ratio of Principal and Interest = 5 : 8

Total interest for 8 years = 8/5 × 100 = 160%

Interest per year = 160%/8 = 20%

questions.question: P can complete a work in 15 days and Q in 24 days. They began the work together but Q left the work 2 days before its completion. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by P = 15 days

Time taken by Q = 24 days

**Concept used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let Total work = LCM of 15 and 24 = 120 units

Efficiency of P = 120/15 = 8 units/day

Efficiency of Q = 120/24 = 5 units/day

Total Efficiency of P and Q = 8 + 5 = 13 units/day

Total work done by Q in 2 days = 5 × 2 = 10 units

Now New Total work = 120 + 10 = 130 units

∴ Total time taken to complete the work = 130/13 = 10 days

questions.question: A bus moves at a speed of 84 km/hr after repairing and moves at a speed of 56 km/hr before repairing. It covers 2x distance in 8 hours after repairing. How much time (in hours) will it take to cover x distance before repairing?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed(SA) of bus after repairing = 84km/h

Speed(SB) of bus before repairing = 56km/h

Distance covered after repairing = 2x in 8 hours

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance traveled/Time taken

**Calculation:**

SA = Distance/Time

⇒ 84 = 2x/8

⇒ x = 84 × 4 = 336 km

SB = Distance/Time = x/Time

⇒ 56 = 336/Time

∴ Time = 336/56 = 6 hours

questions.question: The perimeter and the breadth of a rectangle are 60 cm and 14 cm respectively. Find its area (in cm²).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of rectangle = 60cm

The breadth of the rectangle = 14cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

Area of the rectangle = l × b

where l → length and b → breadth

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of rectangle = 60

⇒ 2(l + 14) = 60 

⇒ l + 14 = 30 

⇒ l = 16 cm

∴ Area of rectangle = 16 × 14 = 224 cm²

questions.question: If the perimeter of a semi-circle is 108 cm, then find its radius (in cm).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Perimeter of semi-circle = 108cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of semi-circle = r(π + 2)

where r → radius of a circle

**Calculation:**

⇒ 108 = r(22/7 + 2)

⇒ 108 = 36/7 × r

∴ r = 3 × 7 = 21 cm
